body: A UPS Airlines Boeing 767 freighter and a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 collided while taxiing at Miami International Airport on Saturday night. According to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the wingtip of the Copa passenger jet struck the nose of the 767 as the cargo aircraft taxied for departure. The collision happened at approximately 9:15 p.m. local time at the intersection of two taxiways. Copa flight 427, a Boeing 737-800 that had just arrived from Tocumen International Airport in Panama City, was taxiing toward its gate, while UPS flight 358, a Boeing 767-300F, was taxiing for departure to Bogota.

Air traffic control had instructed the UPS crew to give way to the 737, and one of its pilots acknowledged the mistake over the radio moments after the collision, saying, "We went too far." After the Copa crew reported, "Somebody hit us," the controller reminded UPS 358 that it was "supposed to give way" to the 737. The 737's pilot later reported, "It seems that we are missing the left wingtip." Two people were treated at the scene for minor injuries, but neither required transport to a hospital. In a statement, the FAA said: "The wingtip of a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 struck the nose of a UPS Boeing 767 while the airplanes were taxiing."

The FAA has opened an investigation into the collision. UPS said it was committed to working with authorities to determine what happened and that its crew was safe; the extent of the damage to either aircraft has not yet been officially confirmed, although images posted on social media show significant damage to the 767's nose. There is a suggestion that a runway change may have added to the UPS crew's workload shortly before the collision: during the radio exchange, one of the pilots said the crew was in the middle of a checklist for a runway change. The collision came a day after a rare nationwide ground stop brought US air travel to a halt, and it follows a similar taxiing collision last month, when a Delta Air Lines Airbus A350-900 struck the horizontal stabilizer of an Air Canada Boeing 777-200LR while taxiing at Los Angeles International Airport.
en.summary: A UPS Boeing 767 freighter kept taxiing past a give-way instruction at Miami and was struck on the nose by the wingtip of a Copa Boeing 737 taxiing to its gate; two people were treated for minor injuries and the FAA is investigating.
en.title: UPS Boeing 767 and Copa Boeing 737 collide while taxiing at Miami airport

body: UPS航空一架波音767貨機與Copa航空一架波音737客機，週六晚間在邁阿密國際機場滑行時相撞。美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）表示，Copa客機的翼尖撞上正在滑行待起飛的767貨機機鼻。碰撞發生於當地時間晚間約9時15分，地點在兩條滑行道的交會處。Copa航空427號班機為波音737-800，甫自巴拿馬城托庫門國際機場抵達，正滑向登機門；UPS358號班機為波音767-300F，正滑行準備起飛前往波哥大。
航管當時已指示UPS機組讓行737客機，UPS一名飛行員在碰撞發生後數刻於無線電中承認失誤，表示「我們滑得太遠了」。Copa機組回報「有人撞上我們」後，航管提醒UPS358本應讓行737；737飛行員隨後回報「左翼尖似乎不見了」。現場有2人接受輕傷治療，均無需送醫。FAA在聲明中表示：「Copa航空一架波音737的翼尖在兩機滑行時撞上UPS一架波音767的機鼻。」

FAA已對此次碰撞展開調查。UPS表示將配合主管機關釐清事發經過，機組人員平安；兩機損傷程度尚未正式確認，不過社群媒體流傳的影像顯示767機鼻損傷明顯。另據報導，跑道更換可能增加了UPS機組事發前的工作負荷：無線電通話中，一名飛行員表示機組當時正在執行跑道更換的檢查表。此次事件發生在全美罕見停飛令隔日；上個月洛杉磯國際機場也曾發生類似滑行碰撞，達美航空一架空中巴士A350-900在滑行時撞上正被拖往登機門的加拿大航空波音777-200LR水平尾翼。
zh.summary: UPS波音767貨機在邁阿密機場滑行時未依指示讓行，遭剛降落的Copa波音737翼尖撞上機鼻；2人輕傷，FAA已展開調查。
zh.title: UPS貨機與Copa客機邁阿密滑行相撞　737翼尖撞上767機鼻、2人輕傷
